2610.06825.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
2610.06825.paper_summary: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.
2610.06825.paper_summary_zh: 科學圖形通常編碼了定量結果，這些結果並不容易以機器可讀的形式獲得，因此準確的圖形數位化對於驗證和重用已發表的研究結果至關重要。然而，目前的模型從真實科學圖形中恢復繪製值的準確性仍不明朗，因為現有的基準主要依賴於合成圖表或僅涵蓋有限範圍的圖表類型。我們介紹了PlotGround，一個自動化流程，用於從真實科學圖形及其作者釋放的源數據中構建圖形數位化基準。PlotGround將圖形映射到源表，識別可重建的面板，並生成帶有源基礎參考值的定量問題。我們使用PlotGround構建了PlotGround-1k，這是一個經過人工驗證的基準，包含來自1,066篇bioRxiv預印本的1,119個問題。在十六個多模態模型中，最佳模型在$\pm 5\%$相對誤差容忍度下達到87.5%的準確率。將容忍度收緊至$\pm 2\%$會使每個模型的準確率下降11-24個百分點，顯示出近似視覺閱讀和精確定量恢復之間的差距。PlotGround的配對圖形-源結構使我們能夠比較從圖形和源表中恢復相同值的準確性。提供源表而不是圖形將編碼代理的準確率從90.0%提高到97.4%，同時將成本降低72%。
